Messages.Author: bryan nelson
Messages.Body:
Blood of Acid: (Sabbatt) In superior form, is the damage that is
aggravated also done to the vampire using the card or only to the
opposing minion? card text: "Only usable at close range before strikes
are chosen. During strike resolution, the opposing minion takes an
amount of damage equal to the damge he or she successfully inflicts.
(superior) As above, but the damage is aggravated.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Only the damage done by Blood of Acid is changed/affected by Blood of
Acid's card text.
